note: Single source of truth for what exists in this folder and how done it is. Every game gets exactly one entry, flat list, regardless of which folder it lives in. Update in the same session as any real change. See CLAUDE.md for the rules.

status.idea: A line or a paragraph. No design doc, no code.
status.designed: GDD written and scoped. Nothing built.
status.draft: Playable first pass. Loop runs end to end but it is rough.
status.iterated: Several edit passes on the draft. Holds up to a real playthrough.
status.polished: Art, juice, audio, and QA pass done. Ship ready.
status.shipped: Live at a public URL, verified. live_url is filled in.
status.shelved: Parked on purpose. Not dead, not being worked.

taxonomy.value: 1 to 5. Worth to the studio. 5 headlines hitfactory.games, 1 exists and that is about it.
taxonomy.complexity: 1 to 5. Cost to get from current state to shipped. 1 is an afternoon, 5 is a long multi-session build with real systems or an engine behind it.
taxonomy.scores_note: First-pass scores set by Claude on 2026-08-27 from folder contents and design docs. Meant to be overridden by Kevin.

games.title: Again Again
games.description: Slingshot an orb through 12 crystal chambers, ricocheting off angled walls to collect every gem in a single throw. Miss and the retry is instant.
games.notes: Game Album slate track 2. Built, never pushed to a repo.

games.title: Ah Mah Day Us
games.description: Myst-style mechanism island. Four linked scenes of dials, organ pipes, and a water clock interlock into one grand machine that sings when solved.
games.stack: single-file HTML + assets folder; DOM/CSS transform layers, WebAudio, zero dependencies, mobile first
games.notes: Gauntlet run, giga-foundry. Bar ratified: Myst soul at modern fidelity, graded against Myst/Riven/Obduction screenshots on disk. Wave 0 passed (real Adobe Stock assets licensed, cut, graded to one palette). Wave 1 passed: the Dial Chamber is playable and tested, 16/16 on desktop and on mobile with real touch drags. Three of four scenes still unbuilt. Open critic gap: the mechanism does not yet inhabit the space the way the bar frames do. See giga-foundry/runs/ah-mah-day-us/PLAN.md and run_notes.md

games.title: Aphelion
games.description: Space exploration built to a No Man's Sky bar. One solar system, four planets, seamless space to surface, on-foot exploration, and modular ship building that drives real flight physics.
games.notes: The giga-foundry quality track run. Round 10 (2026-09-02) cleared five silent bugs that had the run blocked since 2026-08-20, then ran the FIRST critic round: three blind critics, three LOSES_TO_BAR, all agreeing on one mechanism - nothing in the build bounces light. Emissive surfaces illuminate nothing, interiors take no fill from the sky, there is no ambient floor. That single fix has leverage across every piece. Orbit shots still render the planet black (diagnosed, not fixed). Run state in giga-foundry/runs/aphelion/workbench.md. Actuals never go into Foundry's calibration log.

games.title: Bass Is the Place
games.description: Cosmic four-lane rhythm game. Notes ride glowing bass strings toward a fret bar, beatmapped from the real track, with a combo multiplier that grows the planet on the horizon.
games.notes: One of the three Deluxxe music games. Pages URL verified live 2026-09-01.

games.title: Big Dawg N Sexyyy
games.description: A chunky neon dog auto-runs a three-lane city block. Swipe lanes to chain pickups into combo multipliers and pop the screen into full bloom when the combo runs hot.
games.notes: Game Album slate track 4. GDD only.

games.title: Dawn Chorus
games.description: It is 5am in a watercolor forest. Echo each bird's song branch by branch and wake the forest into a sunrise symphony. Five birds, no fail state, only prettier and uglier paths to dawn.
games.stack: single-file HTML5 canvas, real xeno-canto field recordings
games.notes: One of the three Aviary bird games. Bird audio is CC licensed and credited in CREDITS.md.

games.title: Dee Over Gee
games.description: Disc golf over gravity. Arc a glowing disc through canyon wind toward chain baskets, three throws per hole, nine holes, par scoring. Touch and wind, not reflexes.
games.notes: Game Album slate track 5. GDD only, still v1. Best raw value-to-effort in the catalog under the old bar, but under the Jimothy bar it has no character to rig: a disc is a shape. Needs the thrower decision (put a rigged thrower on the tee) before build, which bumps it S to M. See Foundry/UPGRADE_PLAN.md.

games.title: The Deluxxe Music Games
games.description: Arcade hub page for three games built on three Deluxxe tracks, with one-tap voting between them.
games.notes: Superseded in intent by the planned Game Album landing page for all 19 tracks. Prior art for the hitfactory.games front door.

games.title: Drive to Hood
games.description: An endless OutRun homage at dusk. Pseudo-3D segment road, weave three lanes of traffic, thread near misses for bonus, spin out but never hard fail while the sky melts gold to violet.
games.notes: Game Album slate track 6. Built, never pushed.

games.title: Eonweaver
games.description: Drag glowing threads star to star to weave eight sleeping constellations to life before the dawn meter fills.
games.notes: Game Album slate track 7, intended as the showcase game for the album landing page. Built, never pushed.

games.title: Factory Cats
games.description: First-person bopping of cats with pool noodles in an abandoned chocolate factory.
games.notes: v0.1 shipped. PRD in the folder covers scope beyond what is built.

games.title: FISSON
games.description: One-tap chain reaction. Fire a single neutron into a drifting atom field and watch the cascade cook, six waves synced to the track.
games.notes: One of the three Deluxxe music games. Pages URL verified live 2026-09-01.

games.title: Friendo
games.description: Toss snacks with a gentle lob to befriend a shy meadow creature. Land them in its comfort ring to build trust until it hops onto the bench beside you. No fail state.
games.notes: Game Album slate track 8. Built, never pushed.

games.title: Gerlok
games.description: AI dungeon master text RPG with a dynamic DM, persistent character state, and four world settings. Runs as both CLI and local web app.
games.stack: Node.js, local web app, LLM API
games.notes: Oldest project in the folder and untouched for over a year. Requires an API key and a local install, which is the main thing blocking it from being shareable.

games.title: Halcyon
games.description: A kingfisher's perfect dive. The river bends the light so where a fish appears is not where it is. Read the refraction, time the tap, dive true.
games.stack: single-file HTML5 canvas with strip-warped refraction layer
games.notes: One of the three Aviary bird games.

games.title: It's That Time Again
games.description: A Frogger homage with modern lighting. Cross five lanes of traffic and four of drifting river, and every clean crossing turns the season and reskins the whole road.
games.notes: Game Album slate track 9. GDD only.

games.title: Jimothy: Prince of Ballard
games.description: The sequel to JimoWEEEEEE. The same caped raccoon, now with legs: run the fences, climb trees and lightpoles, cross the rooftops, and get home before dark.
games.notes: Deploy bundle also staged in Foundry/publish/. Repo URL not recorded in the folder; confirm before treating the repo field as empty.

games.title: JimoWEEEEEE!
games.description: A short stumpy caped raccoon flaps over the housetops at sunset, threads the gaps, and grabs the trash. Flappy bones with a combo multiplier and a WHEW bonus for near misses.
games.notes: Predecessor to Jimothy: Prince of Ballard. Cheapest thing in the folder to actually ship.

games.title: Runo
games.description: A dark cinematic side-scroller through two episodes of the Finnish Kalevala. Tap glowing runes to hear verses and watch the world answer: eggs crack into mountains, the Sampo mill spins, a goddess's storm chases you. Every brushstroke generated in code.
games.notes: Mobile pass done including a rotate-to-landscape gate and app icons. Pages URL verified live 2026-09-01.

games.title: Knew Ear
games.description: A painterly attic in warm window light holds twelve tucked-away treasures. Each find adds an instrument layer to the ambient mix, so the room composes itself as you search.
games.stack: single-file HTML5 canvas with pan and zoom, mobile first
games.notes: Game Album slate track 1. GDD only. Needs real illustration work, which is the cost driver.

games.title: Longhair
games.description: A momentum glide through procedural wind canyons. Hold to dive and build speed, release to rise, with a twenty-segment ribbon of hair that makes your momentum readable at a glance.
games.notes: Game Album slate track 10. GDD only.

games.title: Lower Falls
games.description: The salmon run. Charge and time leaps up twelve waterfalls through moving gaps in the curtain, dodge eddies and a telegraphed bear paw, reach the spawning grounds.
games.notes: Game Album slate track 11. GDD rewritten to template v2 (jimothy-grade) 2026-09-02; v1 at gdd_v1_archive.md. Next build and the proving run for the upgraded Foundry pipeline (rig stage, harness, blind critic, three iterate rounds). HERO ART: original watercolour salmon by Susan Windsor Fine Art, used with permission, credited in CREDITS.md. Dead-straight lateral profile, which is what the rig needs. WORLD ART CUT 2026-09-02: 26 sprites (4 parallax bands, 16 props, 6 ambient life) generated to match the painting and cut with Foundry/tools/sheet_cut.py, indexed in assets/atlas_props.json. SALMON CUT 2026-09-02 with Foundry/tools/paper_cut.py: salmon_raw.png (signature removed, rig source) and salmon_painting.png (signature intact, title screen), both 1600x581 RGBA. Gate 1 verified, reads at 128px. BEAR CUT 2026-09-02: bear_raw.png 1162x749, graded riggable (strict lateral, standing four-square, paws separated; upper legs merge into the body which is normal and cut with authored polygons). Bear beats rewritten to stay four-square since 2D rotation cannot produce a rear from a standing pose. ART COMPLETE: 29 assets. Only remaining unknown is the chained-flex rig variant (a fish bends, it does not swing limbs). Art direction is watercolour throughout. See Foundry/UPGRADE_PLAN.md, jimothy_standard.md, art_brief.md.

games.title: Mick the Plumber: Pipe Panic
games.description: SMB3-style pixel platformer through a flooded sewer. Real momentum physics and a run button, with wrenchable valves that drain, redirect, and jet water to open the path to the Master Valve.
games.notes: v2 full rebuild after v1's auto-runner physics were judged below par. The five upgrade axes from that retro (agency, momentum, obstacle variety, visual richness, clarity) are the house standard now. Pages URL verified live 2026-09-01.

games.title: Motif of the Cadence Collective
games.description: Narrative rhythm adventure in a neon-futurist world where music is magic. A band of misfits fights the Monotone regime through Guitar Hero style combat, music theory puzzles, and staged performances.
games.notes: The most ambitious non-giga project here and the only Godot one. Touched recently. Scope is a full narrative game, so it needs either a real cut-down or a giga-foundry style commitment.

games.title: Mood Bindigo
games.description: A chill no-fail firefly light mixer. Shepherd red, green, and blue fireflies into clusters, blend their light additively, and deliver each blend to a lantern asking for that shade.
games.notes: Game Album slate track 12. GDD only.

games.title: Murmuration
games.description: Draw the sky. Three hundred starlings follow your finger through rings of dusk light while a falcon hunts the heart of the swarm.
games.stack: single-file HTML5 canvas, boids on a spatial hash
games.notes: One of the three Aviary bird games and the strongest demo piece in the library.

games.title: Oops I Spilled the Chocolate
games.description: Tilt the world so a viscous river of chocolate winds around shelves, funnels, and paddles into the waiting cup. Score is percent collected.
games.stack: single-file HTML5 canvas, verlet fluid with metaball rendering
games.notes: Game Album slate track 13. GDD only. Flagged in the slate as an Opus escalation candidate for fluid feel.

games.title: Oregon Fail
games.description: A reverse Oregon Trail. You tried the off-grid dream out west, the wifi was bad and the yurt was still two grand a month, so now you are limping back east in a creaky VW bus.
games.stack: vanilla JS static site, no backend
games.notes: Snack Dash V1 shipped 2026-09-01: a self-contained rewrite of the shop minigame (snack-dash-v1.js/css) that overrides window.startSnackDash at load, verified live. Same day the Supabase play counter was retired: its project (wvvedaebslmainspcjdq) now returns NXDOMAIN, so supabase.js was deleted and the count hardcoded to 417. There was never a leaderboard, only that counter, so the site has no backend at all now. Deploy path: the git repo is the NESTED Oregon-Fail/ folder inside Oregon_Fail/, remote kevin-sotka/Oregon-Fail, GitHub Pages off main. The outer folder is a loose working copy, so changes must be copied into the nested repo to ship. Folder is still messy (duplicate working copy, playthrough video, stray 'oregon fail' dir). Worth a cleanup pass. Live URL uses capitalized Oregon-Fail; the lowercase form 404s.

games.title: Riventide
games.description: A text-based fantasy RPG with atmospheric graphics and region-specific audio. Character classes, companions, and a hand-built world across many regions.
games.stack: Vanilla JS browser build (story graph generated from world.py); Python/pygame desktop build
games.notes: Live site is now the vanilla-JS build in web-js/, published to docs/. Loads in ~2s on ~440KB (story graph plus one background) instead of the pygbag build's ~32MB and 60-90s, streams assets per scene, and works on mobile. story.json is generated from game/world/world.py by tools/extract_story.py, so the story is still edited in one place and the desktop pygame build is unchanged. The pygbag build had been hanging forever on load (its vtx terminal computes a negative font size when body height is 0, starving the async loop); that is fixed at 15f88f9 and kept in history as a rollback. Known gaps: no combat (2 trigger_combat choices are cosmetic), and 8 orphaned locations that are orphans in world.py too. MISSING_ASSETS.md is the remaining punch list.

games.title: Sniffle Eepagus
games.description: Hold to inhale and pull goodies toward a round big-nosed critter, release to puff hazards away. Chunky pixel waves of snacks and pests, with inhale-versus-puff timing as the whole tension.
games.notes: Game Album slate track 14. GDD only.

games.title: Snow Day Tycoon
games.description: A top-down snowplow tycoon. Clear snow-covered streets for cash, then buy, unlock, and upgrade a fleet of bigger rigs. Endless sandbox with no game over, just more snow.
games.notes: Built in the Foundry at a solid rather than polished bar. Persistent state and several screens, so it is the largest single-file game outside the album slate.

games.title: Splice Lab
games.description: A hybrid creature mixer. Stitch a head, torso, and legs from a roster of cartoon humans and aliens into one body. Exquisite corpse meets sci-fi character creator.
games.notes: The GDD records a deliberate design reframe away from recombining photos of real people toward original illustrated characters. Keep that reframe if the roster is ever expanded.

games.title: The Aviary
games.description: Hub page for the three bird games with one-tap voting between them.
games.stack: single-file HTML, Firebase Realtime Database for votes
games.notes: Closest existing thing to what hitfactory.games needs to be, at three games instead of the whole library. Read this before designing the site.

games.title: Tow Jam & Merle
games.description: Haul Merle's fragile cargo on a springy tow rope over rolling hills. Manage momentum so the piano survives; too much bounce and it breaks.
games.notes: Game Album slate track 15. GDD only.

games.title: Westline
games.description: A golden-hour western shooting gallery along a desert rail line. Quick-draw pop-up targets, ricochet trick shots off spinning signs, three timed rounds of score attack.
games.notes: Game Album slate track 16. GDD only.

tools.title: SodClaw Game Foundry
tools.description: Turns a one-line prompt into a playable game through design, build, polish, test, and deploy, picking the cheapest model tier that clears the bar at each stage. Runbook is the game-foundry skill; estimates in estimate.py, actuals in calibration_log.jsonl.

tools.title: Giga Foundry
tools.description: One game at a time, built against a real external quality bar and looped until it wins or Kevin stops the run. Runbook is the gauntlet-loop skill. Run actuals stay in runs/ and never touch Foundry's calibration log.

tools.title: Swatches
tools.description: A small color swatch page. Not a game.

tools.title: Foundry probes
tools.description: Harness probe scripts (jsdom, steering, smoke test) used by the Foundry pipeline. Not a game.
